strings.name: Stephen Schwarzman
strings.summary: Educated at Yale and Harvard Business School, Schwarzman led mergers and acquisitions at Lehman Brothers before co-founding Blackstone with Peter Peterson in 1985. It expanded from advisory work into private equity, property and credit, listing in 2007. He also supports Tsinghua's Schwarzman Scholars and MIT computing education and participates in US politics. The Trump business forum he chaired dissolved amid controversy in 2017.
